newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill starts CapStar.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill starts CapStar.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said its analyst Peter Oakes started CapStar Hotel Co as a near-term buy and a long-term accuumulate.
-- Oakes said he set a 12-month price target of $23 to $24 per share.
-- He said he expected CapStar to produce earnings of $0.73 per share during the 1996 year and $1.15 per share in 1997.
-- Asked what attracted him to the stock, Oakes said that, "First and foremost, I would say valuation. I rule it as well undervalued relative to the peer group," he said.
